name: quality_validate_pass
description: A well-scored, well-justified, independent review artifact passes the harness

name: quality_validate_fail
description: A poorly-scored or thin-justified review artifact is rejected by the harness

name: quality_review_required
description: A genuine, fresh, independent review artifact must exist before gates pass (G3 presence, fail closed)

name: quality_validate_nofamily
description: A review artifact missing author/reviewer family is REJECTED (independence cannot be established, fail closed)

name: quality_validate_family_spoof
description: A review artifact whose families differ only by case/padding is REJECTED (normalized to equal = correlated)

name: quality_validate_family_homoglyph
description: A review artifact whose families are Unicode homoglyphs of the same name (fullwidth) is REJECTED (NFKC collapses to equal = correlated)
